title: Point A to Point Z — BuilderOS + LifeOS Cognitive Spine

steps.name: Publish 10/10 definition and external benchmark
steps.acceptance: Document exists, cites real comparable systems and benchmarks, and defines measurable 10/10 ratification gate.

steps.name: Phase 0 audit of existing cognitive-spine components
steps.acceptance: Audit classifies every component as EXISTS / EXISTS BUT UNWIRED / PARTIAL / DUPLICATE / OBSOLETE / MISSING and identifies naming/authority collisions.

steps.name: Resolve naming and authority collisions
steps.acceptance: Keep 'responsibility' as the backend/constitutional term; 'office' is UI copy only. Do not create a separate 'Efficiency Office'; extend the existing 'cfo' responsibility. Do not merge Cognitive Core with Lens Registry.

steps.name: Define bounded trigger for Chair reasoning in live conversation
steps.acceptance: Precise condition that classifies a turn as a real founder decision or explicit 'think this through' request; no cheap-tier model on classification.

steps.name: Wire composeReasoning into runChairNativeTurn for bounded trigger
steps.acceptance: A grep-able caller outside `cognitive-chair.mjs` and its own tests invokes `composeReasoning` from `runChairNativeTurn` when the trigger fires.

steps.name: Capture live founder decision into founder_decision_log
steps.acceptance: On a positive trigger, `recordFounderDecision` is called with `source: 'live_conversation'` and enough context to be legible later.

steps.name: Score answering model into model_capability_ledger
steps.acceptance: The model call that answers the decision-bearing turn is wrapped with `recordModelOutcome` under role `founder_intent_modeling`.

steps.name: Persist structural lens disagreement
steps.acceptance: Chair synthesis output includes a `named_disagreements` field and downstream consumers store it, not narrate it away.

steps.name: Reasoning Plan schema and gate before implementation
steps.acceptance: No mission proceeds to lens selection without a persisted Reasoning Plan artifact; schema covers intent, questions, evidence, responsibilities, lenses, budget, and reality measure. The Reasoning Plan begins with a Constitutional Decision Engine classification: reversibility, cost-of-error, security, money, customer data, constitutional behavior, and local vs system-wide scope. Those answers automatically determine reasoning budget, number of responsibilities, SENTRY mandate, founder-approval requirement, Blueprint Authority gate, and external-research requirement.

steps.name: Enforce independent reasoning structurally in lens composition
steps.acceptance: No lens prompt is constructed with another lens's conclusion until that lens has returned its own output; unit tests confirm isolation. Knowledge (what we know / retrieval / evidence) is structurally separated from Judgment (what we should do / decision / recommendation) in the Reasoning Plan, lens prompts, and Chair synthesis.

steps.name: Consensus, not compromise — synthesis with named disagreements
steps.acceptance: Multi-lens synthesis returns positions, named disagreements, per-lens/per-responsibility confidence scores, and either a reasoned decision or an explicit unresolved-disagreement escalation; no averaged answer. The Chair reports propagated overall confidence and the primary limiting factor (e.g. 'Overall recommendation confidence: 71%, limited by Competition at 42%'). An explicit `unknowns`, `assumptions`, `risks`, and `evidence_needed` list is produced and must shrink before the mission reaches DONE.

steps.name: Generate real Blueprint artifact from cleared consensus
steps.acceptance: Blueprint contains purpose, users, business, competition, UX, architecture, acceptance criteria, failure modes, implementation order, SENTRY plan, and reality metrics. Every mission carries a Decision Reversibility classification (Type A fast, Type B moderate, Type C founder/Blueprint Authority/SENTRY). Goals are decomposed Goal → Objectives → Missions → Tasks → Steps → Evidence → Receipts. Health-metric hooks (blueprint drift, constitution drift, truth accuracy, confidence calibration, consensus time, mission completion time, founder interruptions, human overrides, asset trust, model ROI, reasoning cost) are defined even if the dashboard is not yet live.

steps.name: Builder Blueprint Readiness Review gate
steps.acceptance: A real check rejects blueprints with missing requirements, ambiguous acceptance, or undefined edge cases and routes them back for revision.

steps.name: Extend Lens Registry with versioning, evidence, and retirement
steps.acceptance: Each lens has `version`, `evidence_count`, `retirement_criteria`, and a `trust_score` backed by real outcome data; Wisdom can flag lenses for retirement.

steps.name: Add adversarial lenses (skeptic, devil's advocate, red team)
steps.acceptance: New lens files define operations, not personality, and are exercised in at least one real mission's reasoning plan.

steps.name: Dynamic lens selection and reasoning budget
steps.acceptance: Chair selects lenses based on mission content; each run declares a budget (small/medium/high/constitutional) and enforces a cap on model calls.

steps.name: Founder-philosophy lens from founder_decision_log
steps.acceptance: Lens evidence source is `founder_decision_log`; it answers 'would Adam likely push back' and never auto-approves.

steps.name: Wire SENTRY assertSentryPassForStep into factory dispatch
steps.acceptance: Factory execute-step calls `runSentryRealityStation` / `assertSentryPassForStep` from the dispatch path; a step cannot reach DONE without a SENTRY PASS receipt.
steps.verify_command: grep -rl 'assertSentryPassForStep\|runSentryRealityStation' factory-staging/factory-core/builder/ services/ | grep -v test | grep -v node_modules

steps.name: Wire Receipt Auditor FAIL-verdict to auto-reopen falsely-done steps
steps.acceptance: When `auditReceipt` returns FAIL for a done step, the step status is reset to `pending` or `blocked` and a receipt is written.
steps.verify_command: grep -rl 'auditReceipt' services/ factory-staging/ --include='*.mjs' --include='*.js' | grep -v 'receipt-auditor' | grep -v test

steps.name: Execute one full product mission from intent to Wisdom update
steps.acceptance: A real product mission produces founder intent → reasoning plan → blueprint → deployed code → SENTRY PASS → Wisdom update, with receipts at each stage.

steps.name: Final 10/10 audit and ratification
steps.acceptance: `builder:preflight` passes, `lifeos:bp-priority:verify` passes, all phase gates pass, demo receipt exists, and `OBJECTIVE_VERDICT` shows `rating_current: 10`.
